description: A side-drawer edit form for the Svelte 5 data grid. Click a row and a drawer slides in from the right with every field of the record, a dirty-state badge, live validation with a summary, Save and Cancel, and Escape and Ctrl+Enter shortcuts. The grid is the list view, the drawer the detail view; the editor mutates a draft copy and Save replaces the corresponding grid row.
keywords: svelte data grid keyboard shortcuts form

faq.question: When is a drawer better than inline editing?
faq.answer: For records with more than four or five fields, or fields that need explanation and validation. Inline editing suits quick numeric tweaks; the drawer suits reviewing a whole application.

faq.question: How does Save update the grid?
faq.answer: The drawer edits a draft copy. On Save the draft replaces the row in the rows array by id, and the grid re-renders that row; Cancel drops the draft.

faq.question: Which shortcuts are wired?
faq.answer: Escape closes the drawer and Ctrl or Cmd+Enter saves, handled by a keydown listener on the drawer element so the shortcuts only apply while it is open.
